**Recipient:** Markus Grassl (codetables.de / QECC)  
**Channel:** Official Web Repository (http://www.codetables.de/)  
**Status:** `pending_human_submission`  
**Corresponding Author:** Alexandre Zanata (EvoByte Project, https://github.com/AlexandreZanata/EvoByte)  

## Package Contents
1. `certificate.json`: Canonical certificate of blind SAT synthesis of Gottesman [[8, 3, 3]] code with 5 independent commuting generators.
2. `null-result-notice.md`: Documented negative bound proving pure circulant CSS codes cannot achieve $d=4$ on 14 and 16 qubits.
3. `verify_structured_certificate.py`: Standalone zero-dep verifier.
4. `reproduce.sh`: 1-click reproduction script.
5. `submission-letter.md` & `submission-letter.txt`.
